recommendation.title: Strengthen Headline Impact
recommendation.description: Add visual punch to the headline through enhanced color contrast, a soft gradient backdrop, or a geometric shape—without increasing its physical size. The moderate attention on the discount message suggests it needs more visual emphasis to register urgency and value immediately.
